english.title: Employer (non licensable work) fail to ensure health record of employee exposed to asbestos is maintained
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, for work with asbestos which was not licensable work and was not exempted by Regulation 3(2) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012, failed to ensure that a health record was maintained and contained particulars approved by the Executive for all of your employees who were exposed to asbestos and ensure that

(A)_[a medical examination in accordance with regulation 22(1)(c) and (2)(a) of those Regulations took place on or before 30 April 2015]_
(B)_[a medical examination in accordance with regulation 22(1)(c) and (2)(a) of those Regulations took place not more than 3 years before the beginning of such exposure]_
(C)_[a periodic medical examination in accordance with regulation 22(1)(c) and (2)(b) of those Regulations took place at intervals of at least once every 3 years, or such shorter time as the relevant doctor required while such exposure continued]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY A COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22(3) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974.

english.notes: These Regulations apply to any work outside Great Britain to which sections 1 to 59 and 80 to 82 of the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974 Act apply by virtue of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 (Application Outside Great Britain) Order 2001 as they apply to work in Great Britain.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (general limit on magistrates' court's powers to imprison), a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months is to be read as a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.
